guideFormulaAndExampleEntries.sourceText: Zero-noise extrapolation estimates an ideal observable from noisy experiments. Ideal folding U -> U(U^dagger U)^k leaves U unchanged; proportional physical noise scaling does not follow automatically. Richardson weights satisfy sum_j c_j=1 and sum_j c_j lambda_j^r=0 for canceled orders r. For scales 1,2 with values 0.8,0.6, linear extrapolation gives 1.0. This is a model-dependent estimate and can amplify variance or exceed physical bounds.
guideFormulaAndExampleEntries.scope: Linear extrapolation native. General Richardson orders, CSS check-matrix import and complete surface-code layout simulation are not installed.

guideFormulaAndExampleEntries.sourceText: A code [[n,k,d]] encodes k logical qubits in n physical data qubits and corrects at most floor((d-1)/2) arbitrary unknown-location errors in the ideal coding sense. Fault-tolerant circuits, syndrome ancillas, decoding and noise assumptions add requirements. CSS checks obey H_X H_Z^T=0 over GF(2); this formula is not the definition of every non-CSS qLDPC code. Surface codes are themselves qLDPC.
guideFormulaAndExampleEntries.scope: Linear extrapolation native. General Richardson orders, CSS check-matrix import and complete surface-code layout simulation are not installed.

guideFormulaAndExampleEntries.sourceText: For one common rotated planar surface-code layout, data+measurement qubits=2*d^2-1, so d=11 gives 241. It is a layout convention, not total machine overhead. No single threshold or physical/logical ratio applies to all architectures.
guideFormulaAndExampleEntries.scope: Linear extrapolation native. General Richardson orders, CSS check-matrix import and complete surface-code layout simulation are not installed.

guideFormulaAndExampleEntries.sourceText: Grover with N items and M marked items: sin^2(theta)=M/N, and ideal success after r iterations is sin^2((2r+1)*theta). The oracle, marked set, initial uniform state and iteration count must be explicit. Increasing r indefinitely does not monotonically improve success. Query complexity scales as Theta(sqrt(N/M)) under the search model.
guideFormulaAndExampleEntries.scope: QFT and phase-estimation toy circuits execute. General VQE/QAOA optimizer, Shor modular arithmetic, multibit modular adder, and Clifford+T synthesis are not installed.

guideFormulaAndExampleEntries.sourceText: Use P subseteq BPP subseteq BQP subseteq PP subseteq PSPACE subseteq EXPTIME. Do not claim these inclusions are all strict. Whether NP is contained in BQP remains open; quantum parallelism does not provide every candidate answer in one measurement. Reference [14] gives the relevant black-box lower-bound context.
guideFormulaAndExampleEntries.scope: QFT and phase-estimation toy circuits execute. General VQE/QAOA optimizer, Shor modular arithmetic, multibit modular adder, and Clifford+T synthesis are not installed.

guideFormulaAndExampleEntries.sourceText: 2026 qLDPC report: the [[1152,580,<=12]] result is a code/decoder performance study under a circuit-level noise model, not a demonstrated machine with 580 logical qubits. The paper gives approximately 2.9e-11 per logical qubit per round at p=0.1%; approximately 1.3e-13 belongs to [[2304,1156,<=14]]. Distances shown are upper bounds. The near-2:1 data-qubit encoding ratio excludes additional hardware overhead. [19]
guideFormulaAndExampleEntries.scope: The supplied guide provides corrections; commercial/2026-study claims are not simulator performance or independently authenticated hardware evidence.

coverage.blankSpanMethod: Whitespace gaps >=2 spaces between nonwhitespace characters in article lines1..93. These are missing symbols/equation fragments, not a reliable count of distinct equations; full equation loss cannot be uniquely counted from erased text.

referenceCorrections: General pure-qubit Bloch geometry does not establish a specific missing Ghidan/Tsirelson derivation.
QFT phase output is not all-output measurement; exact tensor factorization is not MPO approximation.
Controlled global phases remain relative phases between control branches.
General density fidelity is not implemented by pure-state overlap.
General Kraus instruments and CV/bosonic/device models require separate backends.
Knill-Laflamme does not require all distinct error subspaces to be orthogonal; degeneracy is allowed.
Parameter-shift assumptions do not automatically provide natural gradients or Hessians.
Closed adiabatic/circuit equivalence does not establish open-system annealer equivalence.
Odd-dimensional Wigner nonnegativity theorems do not transfer unqualified to qubit representations.
Specific2026qLDPC and commercial hardware claims remain dated source claims, not calculator benchmarks.
